spans.text: Exclusion criteria for youths with PTSD at study entry included IQ <70; history of psychotic disorder, bipolar disorder, or obsessive-compulsive disorder; active suicidality; recent (past 4 weeks) substance abuse or dependence; unstable medical condition; recent use of psychotropic medication (past 4 weeks, 6 weeks for fluoxetine); MRI contraindication; and pregnancy in female adolescents.
